facts.fact: Cameroon's telecoms regulator took part in the 4th extraordinary session of ARTAC, the Central African regulators' assembly, in Libreville on 20-21 October 2026, per ART Cameroon.

Central African telecoms regulators fixed ARTAC's headquarters in Cameroon and gave Cameroon's regulator the right to appoint the executive secretary, at the 20-21 October 2026 Libreville session, per ART Cameroon.
